title: Static cascade plan (cascade-state.json init payload)
description: Planner task list consumed by `cascade.py init` / `cascade.py replan`. The controller's stdlib validator in cascade.py (validate_plan) is the executable authority; this schema is the documentation artifact and mirrors it exactly. See policy/STATIC_CASCADE_SPEC.md section 4.

goal.description: Goal statement for the whole cascade.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; the controller fills it if absent.

k3_direct_cost_estimate_usd.description: Planner self-estimate; logged as a calibration data point only, NEVER used as the cost ceiling (spec section 7).

cost_ceiling_usd.description: User-supplied per-goal ceiling until metered history exists. The controller derives cost_warning_usd = 0.5x ceiling; dispatch stops at the ceiling.

cost_used_usd.description: Optional starting cost (normally 0; maintained afterwards by evals/meter.py).

verifier_set.description: Workspace-relative paths of the FROZEN verifier set (test paths, lint/type configs). Every file must exist at init; sha256 hashes are snapshotted and ANY later change is an automatic reject + escalate (spec section 6).

executor.description: flash->ds-flash-worker, pro->ds-pro-worker, k27->k27-worker (delegate profiles, must exist in the agents config), k3->native orchestrator subagent.

pro_reason.description: REQUIRED non-empty when executor is 'pro' (spec section 3): no deterministic verifier, cross-file reasoning, or prior flash failure on the same subsystem.

verification.description: Exactly one of the two shapes.

deterministic.description: Command the controller re-runs itself (shell=False, POSIX-shlex split; use forward slashes and quote paths on Windows). Worker-reported output is never trusted.

scope.description: Workspace-relative paths the task may touch; used for packet text and post-hoc diff inspection (containment itself is delegate's allowed_workspace_roots).

criticality.description: high adds +1 executor-attempt cap (5->6) and +1 QC cap (2->3).

vision.description: Planner-set vision marker (spec 9.1 v3.1). Vision-bearing tasks (vision: true OR image-file extensions in scope: .png .jpg .jpeg .gif .bmp .webp .tiff) require a vision-capable executor: k27 or k3. flash/pro are text-only and are rejected at init and again at dispatch.

max_attempts.description: Per-rung attempt budget; resets on each escalation (spec section 5).
